secrets.name: CI_GATE_APP_ID
secrets.scope: Trusted GitHub Actions gate publisher only.
secrets.purpose: Identify the dedicated GitHub App that is the sole trusted producer of the required CI gate check.
secrets.rotation_procedure: Create or select the replacement checks-only GitHub App, update this GitHub Actions secret, publish a successful gate check, bind the required status check to the replacement App, and retire the previous App installation.

secrets.name: CI_GATE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.scope: Trusted GitHub Actions gate publisher only.
secrets.purpose: Mint a short-lived installation token for the dedicated CI gate GitHub App.
secrets.rotation_procedure: Generate a replacement private key in the dedicated GitHub App, update this GitHub Actions secret, verify an App-authored gate check, and delete the previous private key.

secrets.name: QODANA_TOKEN
secrets.scope: GitHub Actions trusted Qodana analysis job only.
secrets.purpose: Authenticate Qodana analysis and report publication from the trusted CI job.
secrets.rotation_procedure: Revoke the token in Qodana Cloud, create a replacement, update the GitHub Actions secret, and verify the trusted Qodana job.

secrets.name: SONAR_TOKEN
secrets.scope: GitHub Actions trusted SonarCloud analysis job only.
secrets.purpose: Authenticate analysis upload to the public PerfSentinelHub SonarCloud project from the trusted CI job.
secrets.rotation_procedure: Revoke the token in SonarCloud, create a replacement, update the GitHub Actions secret, and verify the trusted SonarCloud job.
